focused.preActivationDiscoveryHome: pass including scheduled-projection and active-projection bucket regressions

findings.detail: The failed boundary was presentation bucketing: a scheduled canonical discovery projection suppressed the matching Event summary even though the Live lane rendered only active projections. The helper now partitions lifecycle first and only de-duplicates summaries against items actually rendered in the active lane.

The patch changes no query, RLS, creator binding, Event access, entitlement or route authority. Public, Circle and private visibility remain server-authoritative; the client only chooses the correct presentation lane for already-authorized records.
The implementation is JavaScript presentation logic plus a deterministic guard. It changes no native capability, provider catalog, Edge Function, database schema, migration, runtime or channel.

The repair retains the same authorized payloads and routes, preserves active Event de-duplication, and adds executable scheduled-versus-live lifecycle proof. Rollback is an internal-v2 OTA to the prior compatible source if physical proof exposes regression.
